name: selectable-tables
description: Make Live Preview tables selectable as whole blocks, like images. Arrow keys to bypass or select, enter to edit.

scripts.lint: eslint . && stylelint styles.css "src/**/*.css" --max-warnings 0 && tsc -p tsconfig.scan.json && node scripts/check-version.mjs
scripts.test-vault: npm run build:preview && node scripts/make-table-notes.mjs --if-missing && node scripts/install-test-vault.mjs --preview
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Brian Frank
